name: Hydraulic press
description: Animates the subject to compress under a studio hydraulic press.
aliases: compress under a studio hydraulic press

prompt.default: The subject begins still, then proceeds to compress under a studio hydraulic press. Material bulges and deforms as the plate lowers. High-speed studio cinematography, physically accurate reflections and particle motion, locked camera.
prompt.kling: The subject begins still, then proceeds to compress under a studio hydraulic press. Material bulges and deforms as the plate lowers. Physically accurate motion, steady locked camera.
prompt.seedance: Locked camera, one continuous shot. The subject begins still, then proceeds to compress under a studio hydraulic press. Material bulges and deforms as the plate lowers. Physically accurate motion.
prompt.veo: The subject begins still, then proceeds to compress under a studio hydraulic press. Material bulges and deforms as the plate lowers. Cinematic lighting, realistic physics, locked camera.
prompt.wan: The subject begins still, then proceeds to compress under a studio hydraulic press. Material bulges and deforms as the plate lowers. Locked camera, smooth realistic motion, high detail.
